phases.title: 范围校验
rules: 只处理授权目标表内资产
被动发现的新资产先进入额外靶标申请队列

phases.title: 低速子域名发现
rules: 完整一键流程默认低速 DNS 发现，单线程、带 delay
新子域名未确认范围前只入待确认和下一轮回流清单
需要把 subdomains_for_next_run.txt 作为输入再次运行，或在确认授权后纳入后续探活

phases.title: 存活探测
rules: 默认低速探测
记录状态码、标题、Server、Content-Type、跳转、长度、首页hash

phases.title: Offline product/OA-specific triage
tools: Nuclei 3.8.0 plus nuclei-templates 10.4.4 as maintained core
afrog 3.5.3 for confirmed Chinese OA products
OA-EXPTOOL and dddd as legacy offline template references
rules: This phase is offline and sends no requests.
Identify specific OA/ERP/CMS/framework/middleware products from existing evidence.
Build a product vulnerability candidate queue for Fastjson, Log4j, Struts2, Spring Boot, Nacos, ThinkPHP, Shiro, and common domestic OA/ERP products.
Map each product to one primary and one sampled backup tool branch.
Classify upload, RCE, SQL injection, deserialization, auth bypass, default-login, and similar templates as approval-required.
Default action is queue_only; no product-specific exploit tool is launched automatically.

phases.title: Apache Shiro rememberMe triage
tools: ShiroAttack2 for later single-target manual verification
rules: Default seeds are Java/login/OA fingerprint targets; use --shiro-include-all only when needed.
Only send baseline GET and an invalid rememberMe cookie probe.
Do not brute force keys, send serialized payloads, execute commands, upload files, or install memory shells in the default flow.
Queue medium/high confidence targets for manual ShiroAttack2 single-target verification under authorization.

phases.title: JS/API 深挖
rules: 只做同站点只读抓取和接口线索提取
一键流程默认启用 Katana，但强制 depth=2、concurrency=1、parallelism=1、rate-limit=1，并设置请求 delay
优先识别 OpenAPI/Swagger、JS source map、上传/导出/下载/查询/管理类接口
不提交写入型 payload，不导出敏感数据

phases.title: 微信小程序与公众号线索发现
rules: 默认从 targets.csv 与 probe_results.jsonl 离线生成单位关键词和搜索 dork
--wechat-miniapp 不再隐式启动 HTTP 探测；只有显式 --probe 或 --wechat-live 才会访问目标
只有显式启用 --wechat-live 时才低速读取首页和同站 JS
发现的小程序/公众号/二维码线索先人工确认主体与授权范围
wechat_subdomain_scan_targets.txt 可作为后续子域名/存活探测输入
微信平台域名和未确认第三方域名进入 wechat_pending_extra_assets.txt，不直接扫描
从同站页面和 JavaScript 中提取后端 API、登录、注册、OAuth、Token 和 Session 线索
需要认证的域名写入 wechat_auth_domains.csv，提醒操作员手工登录并将 Cookie 仅保存到本地 auth_sessions.local.json
新发现域名必须先确认归属和目标审批；不会因为域名看似属于广西单位就自动扫描

phases.title: API 端点只读确认
rules: 只确认高优先级 GET 风格端点
跳过 upload/import/export/download/delete/update/save/pay/password/file 等风险关键词
只记录状态、类型、长度、hash、标题和 JSON 结构，不保存响应正文

phases.title: XSS 候选与安全反射检查
tools: nuclei/dalfox/xsstrike for later single-candidate manual validation
rules: Only consume discovered parameterized URLs from API/JS/Katana/miniapp outputs.
Automatic mode sends one random inert marker in a GET parameter and checks whether it is reflected.
Do not submit stored locations such as comments, feedback, nickname/profile, tickets, announcements, or articles automatically.
Do not send script tags, event handlers, blind-XSS callbacks, POST bodies, cookie/token capture, or response-body persistence.
Marker reflection is a candidate signal only; executable XSS proof requires manual single-candidate review.

phases.title: SQL injection low-impact triage
rules: This is retained shallow SQL injection triage, not proactive or broad SQL injection scanning.
Only test discovered parameterized GET URLs from JS/API discovery, API confirmation, katana output, or scoped target CSV.
Do not use time-based payloads, UNION extraction, stacked queries, database enumeration, dump options, or write payloads.
Treat HTTP 500/status changes as triage anomalies only; do not call them confirmed vulnerabilities by themselves.
Mark high probability only when DB error signatures appear after payloads or a stable boolean true/false differential is observed.
Run sqlmap only later on one approved candidate URL at a time with risk=1, level=1, technique BE, delay, and no dump/destructive options.

phases.title: 人工登录交接与认证态 API 深挖
requires: operator-created account or approved test account
tools: browser developer tools or approved proxy
rules: 主流程自动生成登录和可注册入口清单，但不自动注册、不爆破、不绕过认证
Cookie 或 Authorization 只从本地会话文件读取，不写入日志和扫描结果
只访问同一授权主机的入口、同站 JS 和少量 GET 型查询接口
JS 中发现的新域名或新子域名只写入待确认资产清单，不直接访问
下载、导出、上传、删除、修改和账号操作只列入人工候选，不自动触发
只保存状态、长度、hash、JSON 字段名和风险标签，不保存响应值或敏感文件

phases.title: IDOR 水平越权差分（只读）
显式弱口令复核（默认不运行）
requires: operator confirms exercise rules allow weak-credential checks
optional --weak-credential-auto-auth-review for transient authenticated read-only follow-up
outputs: 00_重要_人工复核入口/06_弱口令显式复核命令.md
rules: Never runs in the default flow; operator must add --weak-credential-review.
Transient authenticated read-only follow-up also requires --weak-credential-auto-auth-review.
Use at most five product-aware common credential pairs per target.
Stop on CAPTCHA, lockout, rate-limit, warning prompts, or first success.
If auto-auth follow-up is enabled, use only cookies/tokens returned by that successful login response, keep them in memory, and never scrape browser tokens.
Do not persist raw passwords, cookies, tokens, or response bodies.
Do not continue to data export, lateral movement, password change, or account modification.

phases.title: Healthcare patient-information exposure triage
tools: manual browser or approved proxy for later single-endpoint confirmation
rules: Enable with --healthcare-profile; live request delay is never below 3 seconds.
Prioritize patient identity, encounters, diagnoses, prescriptions, LIS/PACS, billing, insurance, follow-up, and mental-health schema indicators.
Process existing run outputs offline and retain only endpoint paths, parameter names, field names, categories, counts, and hashes.
Never retain patient values, response bodies, reports, images, exports, tokens, cookies, or downloaded files.
Database, PACS, VPN, network-device, and internal-service endpoints remain separate manual or approval-gated queues.

phases.title: 高价值路径发现
rules: 只看存在性和元信息
不提交写入型 payload
不下载敏感数据

phases.title: 真伪验证
rules: 对比首页 hash 和候选路径 hash
检查响应长度、Content-Type、状态、标题和语义关键词差异
识别 SPA 首页、统一错误页、登录跳转页
候选需要结构差异和语义证据同时满足
记录复核理由

phases.title: 风险分级与审批闸门
rules: 弱口令、命令执行、文件上传、数据库访问、webshell、内网扫描必须审批
未审批时不进入可利用性测试

phases.title: 最小化漏洞验证
rules: 只证明存在
不扩大影响
不导出、不下载、不留存敏感数据

phases.title: 高风险可利用性测试
rules: 默认禁用
能证明权限或影响即停止
禁止改密码、删改数据、上传持久化后门
